ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 5
   D. 13

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 10

5. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 9
   D. 20

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

7. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 73

9. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 48

12. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 50

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

15. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

16. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 8
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 13 − 5
3. x = 8
Final Answer: x = 8
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:

2. Substitute values: c² = 6² + 8²

Final Answer: 10 cm
